skills.name: patentability
skills.description: Search patent prior art and map invention features against references. Use when evaluating ideas or invention disclosures, conducting semantic patent searches, finding similar patents, or preparing prior art search reports. Produces structured reports with feature coverage mapping. Supports patent counsel—does not constitute legal advice; further searching and attorney review recommended. Triggers on "patentability search", "patentability assessment", "novelty search", "is my invention patentable", "prior art search for patentability", "find prior art for my invention", "invention disclosure", "can I patent this".
headings: C.2 Decomposing Complex Inventions into Sub-Queries
